result.OPEN_SCRIPT:
on run argv
	set agentCommand to item 1 of argv
	set agentTitle to item 2 of argv
	set placement to "last"
	set placeRef to ""
	set keepFocus to false
	if (count of argv) > 3 then
		set placement to item 3 of argv
		set placeRef to item 4 of argv
	end if
	if (count of argv) > 4 then set keepFocus to (item 5 of argv) is "background"
	tell application id "com.googlecode.iterm2"
		set w to missing value
		if placement is "session" then
			repeat with cw in windows
				repeat with ct in tabs of cw
					repeat with cs in sessions of ct
						if (unique ID of cs) is placeRef then set w to (contents of cw)
					end repeat
				end repeat
			end repeat
		else if placement is "dedicated" then
			repeat with cw in windows
				if ((id of cw) as text) is placeRef then set w to (contents of cw)
			end repeat
		end if
		if w is missing value and placement is not "dedicated" and (count of windows) > 0 then set w to current window
		if w is missing value then
			set w to (create window with default profile command agentCommand)
			set s to current session of current tab of w
		else
			set previousTab to current tab of w
			tell w to set t to (create tab with default profile command agentCommand)
			set s to current session of t
			if keepFocus then tell previousTab to select
		end if
		set name of s to agentTitle
		return (unique ID of s) & linefeed & ((id of w) as text)
	end tell
end run
result.LIST_SCRIPT:
on run argv
	if application id "com.googlecode.iterm2" is not running then return ""
	set out to ""
	tell application id "com.googlecode.iterm2"
		repeat with w in windows
			repeat with t in tabs of w
				repeat with s in sessions of t
					set out to out & (unique ID of s) & linefeed
				end repeat
			end repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	return out
end run
result.CLOSE_SCRIPT:
on run argv
	set sessionId to item 1 of argv
	if application id "com.googlecode.iterm2" is not running then return "missing"
	tell application id "com.googlecode.iterm2"
		repeat with w in windows
			repeat with t in tabs of w
				repeat with s in sessions of t
					if (unique ID of s) is sessionId then
						close (contents of s)
						return "closed"
					end if
				end repeat
			end repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	return "missing"
end run
result.INPUT_SCRIPT:
on run argv
	set sessionId to item 1 of argv
	if application id "com.googlecode.iterm2" is not running then return "missing"
	tell application id "com.googlecode.iterm2"
		repeat with w in windows
			repeat with t in tabs of w
				repeat with s in sessions of t
					if (unique ID of s) is sessionId then
						set wakeLine to item 2 of argv
						tell (contents of s)
							write text wakeLine newline false
							delay 0.2
							write text ""
						end tell
						return "sent"
					end if
				end repeat
			end repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	return "missing"
